title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in nK Ghost Kit…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in nK Ghost Kit through version 3.8.1. This vulnerability allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, potentially enabling attackers to inject malicious scripts that execute in users' browsers. The vulnerability is rated high severity with a CVSS score of 7.1.
